column1: In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past and to rewrite history to their own warped view. The Radical Left is doing it now, and they are doing it at a level that nobody has ever seen, and that includes the media. They are trying to tear down monuments, change names, and erase our heritage. We can't let them do it.

Before turning to the topic at hand, I want to provide a brief update on the situation with the great state of Iowa. We had a fantastic, the greatest results in the history of anything. We did incredible things, and people are, frankly, very happy. And now, they want to see us win. We had tremendous success, and lots of people were, you know, very impressed with the job.

No, they say worse; they say negative. They say negative. They're going to make the wrong determination. I'm not going to be able to stand to have anything in the building, and I'll be involved in a big thing. And we're going to get them. We're going to get them. You'll see. And we're doing very well. We will be very strong.

It is time for North Korea to realize that the denuclearization is its only acceptable future. They have been told this many times. We’re in a great position to make a deal, a deal that would be very good for North Korea and, frankly, very good for the world. We will see what happens. But a lot of progress has been made, and Kim Jong Un has been, frankly, very good. And a lot of people respect that.

And then now the next slide is a nine-city roll-up. And so to save a lot of time, because I know how much time we're wasting, we're going to go to the nine-city roll-up. Let's go. And we have great, great experts that are going to be up here. And we have brilliant people. We have some of the most brilliant people anywhere in the world.
